messages:
dana: FYI customer EdgeOptics just sent a billing dispute - they were charged twice for March Reserved GPU pool. Attached screenshot of invoice and portal.
ajay: Please paste invoice id and the exact duplicated lines so I can pull ledger traces.
dana: Invoice INV-2026-0319-442. Duplicated lines: RESERVED-GPU-POOL (Mar) x1 $6,195.00 and RESERVED-GPU-POOL (Mar) x1 $6,195.00. Customer asking for full reversal of the duplicate $6,195.
edgeoptics-support: Confirmed on our end: only one subscription active. We saw a duplicate POST from our billing webhook at 2026-03-19T14:02:13Z. Looks like our retry logic fired incorrectly.
lucy: If the duplicate was accepted by our ingestion, we should issue a credit. Quick check: any taxes or fees tied to that line?
dana: Invoice shows subtotal $12,390.00, taxes $0, total $12,390.00. So refund amount equals line price $6,195. No extra fees.
finance-bot: Note: refunds >$5k require finance manager approval + legal ack per FIN-REF-3 policy.
maria: Looping in legal. I need a short justification and confirmation this is one-off. Also please file an engineering incident if this is platform acceptance of duplicate events.
sanjay: Customer is small but engaged. They want this handled quickly; sales will get a note from them confirming the duplicate post.
ajay: I pulled our event log - two identical consumption events accepted at same timestamp; idempotency key missing for that webhook route. Opening ENG-INC-2026-279 assigned to eng-runtime.
lucy: Ops steps: create credit memo then issue refund. Billing-tool commands I will run after approvals: 
```nbilling-tool credit-create --customer cust_4E9K --invoice INV-2026-0319-442 --amount 6195.00 --currency USD --reason "Duplicate reserved capacity charge (Mar)" --gl-code REV-ADJ
billing-tool refund-issue --customer cust_4E9K --amount 6195.00 --method stripe --note "Refund duplicate reserved capacity charge"
```
(dana, please confirm amount and legal ack first)
dana: Requesting approval: $6,195.00 goodwill credit + refund to EdgeOptics. Root cause: our ingestion accepted a duplicate POST. Engineering will file incident.
maria: Approve contingent on: 1) ENG incident id filed, 2) sales gets written confirmation from customer that they will patch their retries, 3) legal signs off that this is a one-time courtesy. Once those are met, finance can process.
ajay: ENG-INC-2026-279 created. Triage scheduled in 3h.
sanjay: I'll get the customer's note and paste here when I have it.
dana: Once legal ack arrives, Lucy please proceed with the credit and refund and paste transaction id. Draft customer message: "We issued a $6,195.00 reversal for the duplicate reserved capacity charge on INV-2026-0319-442. Our engineering team has opened ENG-INC-2026-279 to investigate. We appreciate your patience."
finance-bot: Refund transaction created: refund_txn_11b3c queued, status: pending_settlement.
edgeoptics-support: Thanks all. We will send the confirmation note to Sanjay today.
dana: Done for now - refund queued and credit memo created. I'll update when settlement clears and include ENG incident link. Thanks :thumbsup:
